page_privacy.title: Privacy Policy
page_privacy.subtitle: Your data, our commitment (GDPR Compliant)
page_privacy.s1_desc: The data controller for the personal data collected on this website is SELY. For any questions regarding your data, you can contact us at the email address: direction@sely.pro.
page_privacy.s2_desc: We only collect the information necessary to process your quote or booking requests: last name, first name, phone number, email address, and the logistical details of your journey.
page_privacy.s3_desc: The purpose of processing your data is to organize our transportation services and billing. The legal basis for this processing is the performance of the service contract between us or the implementation of pre-contractual measures (quotes).
page_privacy.s4_desc: Your data is strictly confidential. It is used exclusively internally by the SELY team and is never sold or transferred to third parties. It may only be shared with our technical service providers (web host, secure payment service) strictly for the purpose of carrying out the service.
page_privacy.s5_desc: Your data is kept for the time necessary for its processing purpose: 3 years after our last contact for prospecting/quote data, and 10 years for billing data (legal accounting obligation).
page_privacy.s6_desc: We implement all necessary technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
page_privacy.s7_desc: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete, limit, oppose, and port your data. To exercise your rights, please contact us by email. If you believe that your rights are not being respected, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (the French data protection authority, www.cnil.fr).
page_privacy.s8_desc: Our website is limited to the use of technical cookies strictly necessary for its proper functioning and your navigation. These cookies do not require prior consent.

security.faq1_q: What is CNAPS accreditation and why is it mandatory?
security.faq1_a: CNAPS (National Council for Private Security Activities) is an administrative public body under the French Ministry of the Interior. Executive accreditation certifies the probity, background vetting, and professional skills required under Book VI of the French Internal Security Code. Only CNAPS-approved entities are legally authorized to organize and coordinate private security and close protection operations in France.
security.faq2_q: Can close protection officers operate in business suits or casual wear?
security.faq2_a: Yes, absolutely. Depending on your preferences and the context of your travel (gala dinners, family leisure, Paris Fashion Week, or executive summits), our agents blend in naturally: high-end dark suits, smart casual attire, or completely discreet covert protection.
security.faq3_q: Do you provide complete motorcades with lead reconnaissance and escort SUVs?
security.faq3_a: Yes. We routinely deploy complete motorcades comprising a lead reconnaissance vehicle, the principal VIP vehicle, and escort SUVs carrying close protection officers and secure luggage.
security.faq4_q: How is the confidentiality of our itineraries and identities protected?
security.faq4_a: Discretion is our absolute hallmark. All drivers, protection officers, and controllers are bound by strict non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and statutory professional secrecy. No itinerary details, schedules, or passenger identities are ever disclosed.
security.faq5_q: How fast can an urgent security detail be mobilized?
security.faq5_a: With our 24/7 operations desk and direct executive involvement, emergency security details can be mobilized in under one hour across the Paris region and major airport hubs.
